continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to Cubicle 7’s Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay Fourth Edition Core Rulebook (SKU CB72400; core product available by December 2018) and its current official product/errata presentation. This is a D100 tabletop roleplaying-game rules-and-setting witness for the Old World, not a merger of Warhammer Fantasy Battle, Warhammer: The Old World, Age of Sigmar, Warhammer 40,000, novels, video games, miniatures games, or other WFRP editions/adventures.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Cubicle 7 Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay Fourth Edition core rulebook, 2018; SKU CB72400 / CB72400PDF

work_or_witnesses.work: Warhammer Fest 2023 Live Blog and Stream

coverage_rule: No individual characters are included. The accessible official core-product description describes player-character categories, settings, powers, threats, and rules but supplies no stable claim-level profile for a named dramatic individual. Species, careers, factions, gods, monsters, magic, items, places, corruption, and rules therefore remain terms/context unless a named dramatic character has adequate primary or official-reference evidence.
omissions: All named individuals, including fictional figures referred to by rules or product copy, because the selected core witnesses do not provide claim-level dramatic profiles.

All characters, events, factions, rules, and outcomes from Warhammer: The Old World, Warhammer Fantasy Battle, Age of Sigmar, Warhammer 40,000, Total War and other video games, novels, miniatures-game publications, and other licensed adaptations.
All characters and plot claims from the Starter Set, Enemy Within, Adventures Afoot in the Reikland, and other fourth-edition supplements; each is a separate work/product witness.
All first-, second-, and third-edition WFRP material and any retconned or converted content not directly stated by the selected Fourth Edition core witness.
uncertainties: Cubicle 7’s December 2018 post confirms that the Fourth Edition core rulebook was already in stores; this audit records 2018 as the product year but does not assert an unverified exact initial street date.

The official current-version register lists CB72400 as ‘version4’ but gives no last-updated date. It establishes a maintenance/version boundary, not a claim that every prior printing or external digital compendium is identical.

The core book is both a rules engine and a presentation of the Old World. Included mechanics and setting terms are not claims about all Warhammer continuities or later Warhammer: The Old World material.
Cubicle 7’s product page identifies the work as Games Workshop intellectual property used under license. No broader license, adaptation permission, or cross-media canon hierarchy is inferred.

The official description foregrounds corruption, altered bodies, disease, violence, secret cults, and destructive threats. These grim-content elements are recorded cautiously as fictional setting/rules context; they are not normalized as real-world moral, medical, religious, or ethnic categories.
evidence_basis: Cubicle 7’s official Core Rulebook product page identifies the Fourth Edition Old World tabletop game, its D100 system, character species, careers, religions/miracles, magical traditions, and core adversity rules; the same page describes Chaos and its consequences. Cubicle 7’s version register supplies the current core-product maintenance boundary, while Games Workshop distinguishes the Old World RPG setting from its other Warhammer game worlds. Accessible evidence contains no claim-level named-dramatic profiles, warranting a terms-only audit.
